kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *bʰeg-der.
Proto-Germanic *bankiz
Proto-West Germanic *banki
Lombardic bankbor.
Italian bancobor.
▲
Lombardic bankbor.
Italian bancabor.
Arabic بنك
From Italian banco and banca, at first actually in the foreignisms بَنْكُو (bankū) and بَنْكَة (banka) in colloquial Egyptian Arabic, and later from French banque. First attested in 1846.
